fx-sip-basics.summary: An SIP is a method to invest a fixed amount regularly in a mutual fund.

points.text: An SIP (Systematic Investment Plan) lets an investor invest a fixed amount of money regularly in a mutual fund scheme.
It is a methodology offered by mutual funds to invest a fixed amount periodically, such as monthly, instead of a lump‑sum investment.

fx-mandate.summary: A SIP mandate is the authorisation you give to debit your bank account for regular mutual fund instalments.

points.text: Investors fill an application and SIP mandate form indicating the date when the pre‑determined amount will be invested.
The mandate allows the fund house to auto‑debit your bank account each month via standing instruction, electronic clearing service or post‑dated cheques.
SIP uses standing instructions so you do not need to write a cheque every month.

next_steps: Review the SIP mandate form you received from the fund house.
